name: io.github.QoreNext-IT/qorenext-mcp
description: Sanctions and trade-screening due-diligence via MCP

environmentVariables.name: QORNEXT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your QornextMCP API key. Get one at https://qorenext-app.azurewebsites.net/signup

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Verify MCP server is operational and get version info. No authentication required.

tools.name: submit_sanctions_screening
tools.description: Submit entities for sanctions screening against global sanctions lists. Required fields: entityEnglishName or entityNativeName (at least one).

tools.name: submit_trade_screening
tools.description: Submit a company for trade screening due-diligence (denied-party checks, risk assessment, negative-news report). Required fields: address, website, and companyEnglishName or companyNativeName (at least one).

tools.name: get_trade_screening_status
tools.description: Get trade screening request status and the full due-diligence report once complete. Required field: request_id.
